decisions.source: National Government Constituencies Development Fund Board — disbursement and audit/public-accountability pages
decisions.reason: The NG-CDF Board publishes constituency allocations and disbursements, and states that Fund utilisation is tracked through constituency internal audit and Board/Auditor-General oversight. The public national surface reviewed does not publish one comparable utilisation-rate percentage for all current 290 constituencies. Disbursement is explicitly a transfer of funds to constituencies for approved projects and is not treated as expenditure/utilisation. The Atlas therefore does not derive a utilisation percentage from allocation or disbursement amounts.
decisions.refresh_trigger: Replace this closure when the NG-CDF Board, Auditor-General or another primary official authority publishes a nationally comparable current-290 constituency utilisation/expenditure table with a common fiscal period and denominator.

decisions.source: Ministry of Health — Kenya Master Health Facility Registry (KMHFR)
decisions.reason: KMHFR provides official facility records with constituency location and can support constituency facility counts. The Atlas indicator, however, is health facilities assessed per 10,000 residents and requires a population denominator aligned to the current 290-constituency boundary and reference period. The governed P23 census review found no direct current-290 constituency population series or authoritative crosswalk supporting that denominator. A facility count is not relabelled as a population density, and no county/sub-county population is inherited downward.
decisions.refresh_trigger: Replace this closure when an authoritative current-290 constituency population denominator aligned to the facility-count reference period is published or can be deterministically derived under an approved boundary crosswalk.

rules: Do not treat NG-CDF allocation or disbursement as utilisation or expenditure.
Do not manufacture an NG-CDF utilisation percentage from unlike fiscal-period quantities.
Do not treat a health-facility count as a per-population density.
Do not inherit county or sub-county population to a constituency denominator.
Every closure must preserve a primary official source, reason and refresh trigger.
